items.scope: Proton AG issues only.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Centreon product issues only.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by Securifera, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments.
Roche’s medical technology products.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Siemens issues only.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Okta issues only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
Vulnerabilities discovered by YesWeHack community hunters on products being tested on the platform with the permission of their owners, as part of Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in runZero products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, runZero that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All ESET products only and vulnerabilities discovered by ESET that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Bizerba products only.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
Microchip Technology products only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to cirosec researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HDF software including HDF5, HDF4, HSDS, HDFView.
All WatchDog products.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Hitachi Energy products only.
Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, Inc.) products only.
Acer issues only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bombadil Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Fuji Xerox and FUJIFILM Business Innovation products such as multifunction devices, printers, production printers, software, and cloud services.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
Yandex issues only.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
Ericsson issues only.
Vulnerabilities in all Ubiquiti products and products of Ubiquiti subsidiaries only.
Synology issues only.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
PaperCut MF, PaperCut NG, PaperCut Hive, PaperCut Pocket, PaperCut Mobility Print, QRdoc, PaperCut Views, PaperCut Multiverse, https://www.papercut.com, and all other PaperCut products and services.
All products and projects in which OpenVPN is directly involved commercially and for OpenVPN community projects, including Private Tunnel.

All products for Haverford Systems brands, PTZOptics and HuddleCamHD (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Haverford Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
